clue.text: Winnie and I beg your indulgence

parts.note: Winnie-the-Pooh is the bear of A. A. Milne's stories
and, in the sense of along with, gives with
I as an object pronoun becomes me

explanation.surface: Someone speaking for both themselves and a famous teddy asks for patience.
explanation.walkthrough: Winnie-the-Pooh, the children's-book bear, supplies the first word; 'and I' reads as 'with me'.
explanation.definitionFit: A polite request for patience while the speaker finishes something, as in asking the listener to wait.

clue.text: Act as spokesman in the end

explanation.definitionFit: To support a cause publicly is to speak up for it; something at the rear sits at the finish of a line.

clue.text: Dependence puts many in totting

indicators.note: the letter for many is placed inside the word for totting up

parts.note: totting up figures is doing addition
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a conventional 'many'

explanation.surface: A habit that makes an accountant lose count of the sums.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Totting' is the British phrase 'totting up', adding figures together.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hooked on a substance or habit is a state of reliance on it.

clue.text: I put in fuse to have power

indicators.note: the single letter is put in the middle of the word for fuse

parts.note: to weld metals is to fuse them

explanation.surface: Fixing a fuse to restore the electric power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fuse' looks electrical but means join metals by heat.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise authority or control over others, as one handles a weapon.

clue.text: Marines presented with enormous flask

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Marines presented with enormous flask' gives only RM + OS (enormous = outsize); the THE needed for THERMOS has no clue word, so the clue appears to have lost a leading 'The'.

clue.text: Retired tecs tucked into dinner after check-up

indicators.note: the reversed detectives are placed within the word for dinner

parts.note: dinner is a meal

indicators.note: retired here means withdrawn backwards, so the letters for tecs are read in reverse

parts.note: tecs are detectives, the Criminal Investigation Department, CID

explanation.surface: Detectives back from duty eat heartily before a doctor's appointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' reverses the detectives' initials and 'tucked into' places them inside the meal; 'tucked into' poses as eating, and 'after' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's examination to confirm health is a routine physical.

clue.text: Needs to get hot dish

parts.note: someone who needs to do something has to do it
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A cook must serve something warm.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish of chopped cooked meat and potatoes, fried together.

clue.text: A cereal served with nut

parts.note: corn is a cereal crop

explanation.surface: Breakfast cereal served with a nut topping.
explanation.definitionFit: The oak's fruit is a nut in a cup.

clue.text: Yet red hair may result from it

definitions.text: Yet red hair may result from it

indicators.note: the letters of the three words may result in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Even ginger hair can be blamed on one's parents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May result' asks for the letters of YET RED HAIR to be rearranged; the whole clue then describes what genes pass down.
explanation.definitionFit: Traits passed from parent to child, such as hair colour, are inherited.

clue.text: Lover from exotic isle

parts.note: fancy, in the sense of elaborate or exotic
the Isle of Man lies in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A holiday romance with someone from a far-off island.
explanation.walkthrough: MAN is the Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated term for a woman's boyfriend or paramour.

clue.text: Many in charge are key personnel

indicators.note: the letter for many goes inside the word for charge

parts.note: having charge of someone is having their care
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred, a conventional 'many'

explanation.surface: The staff who run things are the essential workers.
explanation.definitionFit: A core group of trained people at the heart of an organisation.

clue.text: Aspire to see revue a don produced

indicators.note: the letters are produced in a new order, as a show is staged

explanation.surface: An academic stages a revue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Produced' is the anagram signal on REVUE A DON, though it reads as staging a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To strive or try hard to achieve something.

clue.text: Of theoretical interest only to lecturer

explanation.definitionFit: A matter of no practical consequence is merely theoretical; a university teacher is a scholar.

clue.text: Beaten for having done wickerwork

explanation.surface: A punished pupil who wove baskets.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrashed with a stick; fitted with woven rattan, as a chair seat.

clue.text: Agent for the lib dems

explanation.walkthrough: The Liberal Democrats are the UK's traditional third force behind the two main parties.
explanation.definitionFit: An intermediary between two sides; Britain's Liberal Democrats long ranked behind Labour and the Conservatives.

clue.text: Evil fellow and I have intelligence

parts.note: a fellow is a he
nous is common sense or intelligence

explanation.surface: A wicked man boasting of his cleverness.
explanation.definitionFit: Shockingly wicked, like an atrocious crime.

clue.text: Neglect old religious settlement

parts.note: a mission is a settlement of missionaries

explanation.surface: An abandoned missionary station falls into disrepair.
explanation.definitionFit: A failure to do something, a lapse or oversight.

clue.text: During pre-Easter period a doctor is radiant

indicators.note: a doctor sits during, so inside, the pre-Easter period

parts.note: Lent is the forty days before Easter
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A physician glows with health during the fasting season.
explanation.definitionFit: Softly glowing or flickering, like a flame.

clue.text: I exalt foe disposed to save his skin!

definitions.text: I exalt foe disposed to save his skin!

indicators.note: disposed, in the sense of arranged, rearranges the letters

explanation.surface: A captive flatters an enemy to escape with their life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disposed' rearranges I EXALT FOE; 'save his skin' plays on the idiom for escaping, while the answer actually means shedding skin.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub off dead surface cells.

clue.text: Calling for operatic cycle in German

parts.note: Wagner's four-opera cycle is known as the Ring

explanation.surface: Asking to hear Wagner's epic in its original language.
explanation.definitionFit: Telephoning someone, in British usage.

clue.text: Pages to be destroyed by old German secret police

indicators.note: the letters are wrecked and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Documents shredded by Nazi agents.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitler's political police force in Nazi Germany.

clue.text: Convicted and ruined

explanation.definitionFit: Found guilty of a crime, in slang; doomed or finished.

clue.text: Best beloved, but superlatively costly

explanation.definitionFit: A term of endearment for a loved one; the highest-priced, comparing three or more.

clue.text: Instruments needed to make casks

explanation.surface: Making barrels for a band.
explanation.definitionFit: Wind instruments such as the organ's tubes; large wine barrels holding about 105 gallons.

clue.text: One in the eye for the aspiring barrister!

explanation.surface: A trainee lawyer gets a poke in the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: At the English bar a trainee barrister spends a year learning under a senior one, and carries this title.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark opening at the centre of the iris; a trainee learning under a qualified barrister.

clue.text: One of the articles she sells on the shore?

definitions.text: One of the articles she sells on the shore?

parts.words: One of the articles she sells on the shore?
parts.note: the tongue-twister 'she sells ... on the seashore' names the items she sells

explanation.surface: A seaside vendor's stock from the famous tongue-twister.
explanation.definitionFit: A mollusc's discarded casing found on beaches.

clue.text: Prior to setback, cardinal gets agitated

indicators.note: the cardinal's letters come prior to, so before, the other piece

parts.note: HE, His Eminence, is the title of a cardinal
read as set back: set is put, and back turns the word round

explanation.surface: A churchman is upset by a recent reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setback' looks like a misfortune, but it is a two-part instruction: a word for 'set' written backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Worked up or flustered, in informal speech.

clue.text: Just a monarch in the middle east

indicators.note: the monarch's letter sits in the letters for middle and east

parts.note: ME is the abbreviation of Middle, as in Middle English
E is the compass abbreviation for east
R, for rex or regina, stands for a monarch

explanation.surface: Merely a king somewhere in the Arab world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The middle east' reads as the region, but splits into Middle (ME) and east (E).
explanation.definitionFit: Only or simply, as in 'a mere child'.

clue.text: Villain about to steal into head's lodging

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: the word for steal goes into the word for head
the head is lodging, so holding, the other piece

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
to rob is to steal

explanation.surface: A thief breaks into a college master's residence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head's lodging' suggests a college master's house, but PATE (head) lodges ROB.
explanation.definitionFit: An unprincipled scoundrel.

clue.text: Manage to find champion going to turkey

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey
an ace is an expert or champion

explanation.surface: A sports star travels to Turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turkey' is disguised in lower case as the bird; it is the country, code TR.
explanation.definitionFit: To track down or locate.

clue.text: Kikuyu leaders accommodate Noel

indicators.note: the words accommodate, so contain, the answer within them

explanation.surface: Kenyan tribal chiefs make room for a man called Noel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaders' suggests first letters, but the answer runs across the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are old names for Christmas.

clue.text: Spokesman needs a set of dentures

explanation.definitionFit: A person who speaks for others; a gum shield or set of false teeth fitting the mouth.
